description: Who ranks where for any search term in one storefront, day by day: the ordered app ids in that storefront's search results, each with its rating count. One call returns up to 1,000 rows (days × depth); pass the ids to hive_app_details for names. 10 credits for up to 7 days, 20 for up to 30, 40 for up to 90.
